name: banner
title: Banner
description: A message about the page or the whole app, inline or floating, in an information, warning, danger or success tone.

when: Telling people something about this page that they need to read or act on.

instead.when: Only an item's status needs showing.

guidance.rule: Say why and what to do; omit the close button for errors that must be resolved.

builtIn: Announced with the right urgency for its tone.
The close button is named "Close" or your `dismissLabel`.
youProvide: A specific `dismissLabel` when "Close" alone is vague.
